xStation ODE installation guide for the PU-18 Playstation 1 motherboard
PU-18 Mainboards can be found in: All SCPH-5001 All SCPH-5501 — 5503 All SCPH-5552 (very rarely) SCPH-7001 — 7003
1. You have to disassemble the Playstation 1 completely to get to the mainboard. PLEASE REMOVE ALL CABLES FROM THE POWER SUPPLY. MAKE SURE THAT THE POWER CORD IS DISCONNECTED!
2. Search for IC701
